name_zh: 切·格瓦拉/阿根廷/古巴/玻利维亚/游击/国际主义革命
description_zh: 切·格瓦拉（1928-1967），阿根廷医生、马克思主义革命家，拉丁美洲最具影响力的国际主义战士。他与卡斯特罗共同领导古巴革命（1956-1959），在新生政权中担任重要职务，推动土地改革和扫盲运动。革命后他离开古巴，在玻利维亚、刚果等地继续推行国际主义游击战略，最终在玻利维亚被俘牺牲。格瓦拉将马克思主义与拉美本土革命实践相结合，其《游击战》著作和'新人'理论对全球反殖民运动产生了深远影响。
description_en: Che Guevara (1928-1967), Argentine doctor and Marxist revolutionary, the most influential internationalist fighter in Latin America. He jointly led the Cuban Revolution (1956-1959) with Castro, holding key positions in the new regime and implementing land reform and literacy campaigns. After the revolution, he left Cuba to continue his internationalist guerrilla strategy in Bolivia and Congo, ultimately captured and executed in Bolivia. Guevara combined Marxism with Latin American revolutionary practice; his writings on guerrilla warfare and 'New Man' theory had a profound impact on global anti-colonial movements.
reason_zh: 切·格瓦拉代表了拉美革命者将马克思主义理论与本土游击实践相结合的典范。他的国际主义精神超越了国界，从古巴到玻利维亚的持续革命实践展现了反殖民斗争的全球视野。其'新人'理论和游击战学说对20世纪全球解放运动产生了不可磨灭的影响，成为反帝国主义斗争的精神象征。
reason_en: Che Guevara represents the paradigm of Latin American revolutionaries combining Marxist theory with local guerrilla practice. His internationalist spirit transcended borders, and his continuous revolutionary practice from Cuba to Bolivia demonstrated a global vision of anti-colonial struggle. His 'New Man' theory and guerrilla warfare doctrine left an indelible impact on 20th-century global liberation movements, becoming a spiritual symbol of anti-imperialist struggle.
steps_zh: 研究格瓦拉在阿根廷的医学教育背景及其拉美旅行中的社会观察
分析1955年与卡斯特罗相识并加入'七二六运动'的革命转折
探讨1956-1958年随卡斯特罗登陆古巴、指挥东部战线和比亚克拉巴战役
评估革命胜利后格瓦拉推动土地改革、工业国有化和扫盲运动的治国实践
总结1965-1967年离开古巴在刚果和玻利维亚的游击战略及其牺牲
steps_en: Study Guevara's medical education background in Argentina and his social observations during Latin American travels
Analyze the revolutionary turning point of meeting Castro in 1955 and joining the '26th July Movement'
Explore 1956-1958 accompanying Castro's landing in Cuba, commanding the eastern front and the Battle of Santa Clara
Evaluate Guevara's governance practice after revolutionary victory, promoting land reform, industrial nationalization and literacy campaigns
Summarize his 1965-1967 guerrilla strategy in Congo and Bolivia after leaving Cuba, and his sacrifice
expected_zh: 掌握切·格瓦拉从阿根廷医生到国际主义革命家的思想转变历程，理解古巴革命中他的军事指挥和治国贡献，评估其游击战理论和'新人'思想对全球反殖民运动的深远影响。
expected_en: Master Che Guevara's ideological transformation from Argentine doctor to internationalist revolutionary, understand his military command and governance contributions during the Cuban Revolution, and evaluate the profound impact of his guerrilla warfare theory and 'New Man' thought on global anti-colonial movements.
case_zh: 1956年12月，格瓦拉与卡斯特罗率82名起义者乘坐'格拉玛号'登陆古巴，在马埃斯特腊山区建立游击根据地。1958年12月，他指挥东部战线发起攻势，攻占比亚克拉巴城，切断了哈瓦那与东部的联系，直接导致巴蒂斯塔政权崩溃。革命胜利后，他担任国家银行行长和工业部长，推动土地改革法令、工业化计划和全国扫盲运动。1965年他离开古巴发表《致第三世界人民的信》，随后在刚果和玻利维亚领导游击战，1967年10月9日在玻利维亚被俘牺牲。
case_en: In December 1956, Guevara and Castro landed 82 revolutionaries aboard the 'Granma' in Cuba, establishing guerrilla bases in the Sierra Maestra. In December 1958, he commanded the eastern front offensive, capturing Santa Clara and cutting off Havana's connection to the east, directly leading to Batista's regime collapse. After revolutionary victory, he served as president of the National Bank and Minister of Industry, implementing land reform decrees, industrialization plans, and a nationwide literacy campaign. In 1965 he left Cuba to publish his 'Letter to the Third World Peoples,' subsequently leading guerrilla warfare in Congo and Bolivia, captured and executed on October 9, 1967 in Bolivia.
cross_cultural_impact: Latin American revolutionary icon, global anti-imperialist symbol
artistic_legacy: 是: 革命文化符号/全球icon
